quote: I'm on a quest to spread happiness throughout the universe-pi!
desc: From the anime Takopi's Original Sin, Takopi is a happian from planet happy, it was sent to earth on a mission to spread happiness to the miserable and sad people of the planet. It wields all sorts of gadgets and gizmos that all do unique and interesting things, some even defy the laws of physics.Takopi is an innocent little creature with no knowledge of things like hatred,harassment, and grief. On planet earth, it meets a girl named Shizuka, an unfortunate girl who is constantly bullied by her peers. Upon seeing Shizuka, Takopi made it his personal mission to make and see Shizuka smile.
